name: Maybank DUO Platinum Mastercard

percent:local.note: Cashback rate on petrol transactions in Singapore and Malaysia.

percent:overseas.note: No minimum spend and no cap.

percent:baseline.note: (Indirect cashback) S$5 = 5 TREATS Points 18,500 points = S$50 cash credit, equivalent to 0.27% cashback.

percent:overseas_online_shopping.note: No minimum spend and no cap.

highlights: 5% cashback on petrol transactions in Singapore and Malaysia, and 1.5% cashback on foreign currency spending, with no minimum spend or cap. Additionally, receive 0.27% cashback on any eligible expenses. Min. spend of S$300 each calendar month to qualify for bonus TREATS Points, capped at 30,000 bonus TREATS.
pros: 5% cashback on petrol in Singapore and Malaysia.
pros: 5 TREATS Points per $5 spent in local currency.
pros: Complimentary Supplementary Cards for your loved ones.
pros: Complimentary travel insurance coverage of up to S$500,000.
cons: TREATS Points awarded calculated based on blocks of S$5.
cons: Min. spend of S$300 each calendar month to qualify for bonus TREATS Points, capped at 30,000 bonus TREATS.

extra.description: Made for drivers, the Maybank DUO Platinum MasterCard allows cardholders to earn 5% cashback on petrol transactions in Singapore and Malaysia. You'll also enjoy 1.5% cashback in foreign currency spend and 5 TREATS Points per $5 spent in local currency.
